$$ロラン$$
「When I realized $$グエン$$ hasn't changed at all, I didn't feel angry or sad. Somehow, I just found it funny...」

508:t_1:91.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Come on! I wasted my time worrying!」

508:t_1:92.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Actually, I thought the same thing too.」

$$ティファ$$
「You thought that too, $$ガロード$$...」

508:t_1:94.en:
$$ロラン$$

$$ロラン$$
(But if $$グエン$$ hasn't changed, then I believe...)

508:t_1:97.en:
$$ロラン$$
(He's always been someone who wouldn't yield to any power, however great...)

508:t_1:98.en:
$$シン$$
「The problem is that the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives have finally made us a direct target of attack.」

508:t_1:99.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And Ensign $$リディ$$ is leading their operations...」

508:t_1:100.en:
$$カツ$$
「Was he... jealous of $$バナージ$$ and $$ミネバ・ザビ$$, and that's why he became our enemy?」

508:t_1:101.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I really don't think that's it...」

508:t_1:102.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You never know. When things are this chaotic, personal feelings can be a powerful motive.」

508:t_1:103.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「In my case, though, I acted with the bigger picture in mind.」

508:t_1:104.en:
$$シン$$
(He covered himself before anyone could call him out!)

508:t_1:105.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
(Isn't this kind of pettiness why he can't surpass the Colonel?)

508:t_1:106.en:
$$カツ$$
「Do you have any idea, $$バナージ$$?」

508:t_1:108.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't worry about unnecessary things, $$バナージ$$.」

508:t_1:110.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If you have no idea what this is about, all you can do is carry on as you are.」

508:t_1:111.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If Ensign $$リディ$$ attacks us as our enemy, we can find out what he's thinking then.」

508:t_1:112.en:
$$シン$$
「$$カミーユ$$ is right. We have plenty of other things to think about.」

508:t_1:113.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「...What is the Colonel doing?」

508:t_1:114.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We haven't heard from him, and $$ネオ・ジオン$$ doesn't seem to have made any notable moves either.」

508:t_1:115.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「At least it seems they haven't summarily executed him.」

508:t_1:116.en:
$$クェス$$
「$$ギュネイ$$! You're talking like that because you're jealous of the Colonel again...!」

508:t_1:118.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「There's no point worrying about that either.」

508:t_1:119.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「In any event, now that the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives are acting openly, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ will respond too.」

508:t_1:120.en:
$$クェス$$
「Then I think $$ハマーン$$ will make a move.」

508:t_1:121.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Why do you think that, $$クェス$$?」

508:t_1:122.en:
$$クェス$$
「The Colonel's return to $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is bound to affect $$ハマーン$$.」

508:t_1:123.en:

508:t_1:126.en:
